brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a plumbing technician to repair a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink.
facts: The pipe under the kitchen sink is actively leaking into a bucket.
The home address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
The homeowner is available tomorrow afternoon.
preferences: Prefers an arrival window after 1:00 PM.
Wants an upfront estimate of costs if possible.
Prefers payment via credit card upon job completion.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, though they may not be able to quote a price until they see the problem

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR_GREETING
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Plumbing. For service scheduling, press 1. For billing and invoices, press 2.

script.label: AGENT1_GREETING
script.text: Thanks for calling Apex Plumbing service scheduling, my name is Mark. How can I help you today?

script.label: AGENT1_ASK_DETAILS
script.text: I can certainly help with that. Could you tell me a little more about what is happening with the sink?

script.label: AGENT1_ASK_ADDRESS
script.text: Got it. May I have the address where the service is needed?

script.label: AGENT1_PRICE_DISCLAIMER
script.text: We are not able to quote any price for this until a technician sees the problem in person, so I cannot give you a figure over the phone.

script.label: AGENT1_INITIATE_TRANSFER
script.text: Let me transfer you directly to Brenda in our local dispatch unit to get your technician assigned.

script.label: AGENT2_GREETING
script.text: Hello, this is Brenda in dispatch. Mark passed along your details for the kitchen sink repair.

script.label: AGENT2_OFFER_WINDOW
script.text: I can book a technician to arrive at your home tomorrow between two and four in the afternoon.

script.label: AGENT2_ASK_NAME
script.text: Could I get your full name and the best callback number for the technician?

script.label: AGENT2_CONFIRM_BOOKING
script.text: You are booked for tomorrow between two and four PM, and the technician will call thirty minutes prior to arrival.

script.label: AGENT2_SIGN_OFF
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Plumbing, and have a great rest of your day.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
